bibl.title: Coptic Interference in the Syntax of Greek Letters From Egypt
bibl.seg: Victoria Beatrix Maria Fendel, Coptic Interference in the Syntax of Greek Letters From Egypt = Oxford Classical Mongraphs.
Oxford, Oxford University Press, 2022, xiv-536 pp., figg. ISBN 978-0-19-286917-3. £ 107,50.

Summary and Conclusion. - Appendix: Corpus of Texts. - Bibliography. Indices.
